The delay was caused by an unexpected issue with our internal workflow that we failed to address promptly. I have since resolved the problem and the work is now complete. You will receive the final deliverables by end of day today.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

Best regards,
